protocol.split: per seed, 20% of normal rows are held out as test normals, the rest is split 80% / 20% into train / validation
protocol.held_out: all rows of the held-out type or category go to the test set and are removed from train and validation; scaler and thresholds never see them
protocol.test: held-out rows (the only attacks) plus the test normals, so recall is recall on the held-out set
protocol.thresholds: max F1, and 1% / 5% false alarms on validation normals, as in evaluate.py
protocol.mixed: unsupervised models fit on the training rows that remain, other attack types included
protocol.normal_only: unsupervised models fit on the normal training rows
